name: 다이얼 8번 돌리기 (Today→Later→Today, 600ms 간격) 동안 프레임 재기
run: await window.todoban.perfMain(); const frames = []; let last = performance.now(); let on = true; const tick = (t) => { frames.push(t - last); last = t; if (on) requestAnimationFrame(tick); }; requestAnimationFrame(tick); const keys = ['ArrowRight','ArrowRight','ArrowLeft','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowRight','ArrowLeft','ArrowLeft']; for (const k of keys) { __e2e.key('.window', k); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); } on = false; const f = frames.slice(2); const sorted = [...f].sort((a,b)=>a-b); const p = (q) => sorted[Math.floor(q * (sorted.length - 1))].toFixed(1); const main = await window.todoban.perfMain(); return { frames: f.length, p50: p(0.5), p95: p(0.95), max: sorted.at(-1).toFixed(1), over20ms: f.filter(x => x > 20).length, over33ms: f.filter(x => x > 33).length, mainCalls: main.length / 2, mainMaxMs: Math.max(0, ...main.map(m => m.ms)).toFixed(1), mainTotalMs: main.reduce((a, m) => a + m.ms, 0).toFixed(1), mainSample: main.slice(0, 6).map(m => m.what + ' ' + m.ms.toFixed(1)) };
